name: mdlockyer-plugins
description: Code-quality plugins: a production code audit that finds and proves bugs, and a behavioral-testing toolkit for tests that can actually fail.

plugins.name: production-code-audit
plugins.description: Audit a codebase the way years of production use would: enumerate, understand, hunt with single-question lenses, reproduce, verify adversarially, then fix with regression tests. Orchestration skill plus five worker agents.

plugins.name: behavioral-testing
plugins.description: Tests that can actually fail: writing guidance, a test-suite audit that proves weak tests with surviving mutants, a gated repair flow, and fail-to-pass bug reproduction. Five worker agents and two hooks.
